title.narrative: A financial support note in the amount of (4,000,000) US dollars to support the project of providing basic health support to children in need in Gaza and the project of supporting life-saving water, sanitation and hygiene needs in the Gaza Strip.

description.narrative: The financial support memorandum aims to support the current humanitarian needs in the Gaza Strip by providing critical and essential medical equipment and supplies for children's healthcare, as well as supporting the provision of life-saving water, sanitation, and hygiene needs in the Gaza Strip.
• - Contributing to reducing the number of deaths and critical cases of children in the Gaza Strip resulting from the lack of medical equipment to provide emergency health care to children.
• Strengthening and empowering the health sector and the water and environmental sanitation sector in the Gaza Strip.
